source: IMA-jet label, EPA 74578-1 (arborjet.com IMA-jet_WebsiteLabel_2020-1.pdf): 2.0-4.0 mL per inch DBH for adelgids, aphids, gall wasps, lacebugs, leafhoppers, leaf miners, mealybugs, psyllids, soft scales, thrips, whiteflies; 4.0-8.0 mL for borers, beetles, royal palm bug, sawfly larvae, spotted lanternfly and the same sap feeders at the higher rate. Under 12 in use the lower rate; over 24 in always the highest; severe infestation, the highest.

source: PHOSPHO-jet label, EPA 74578-3 (arborjet.com PHOSPHO-jet_websitelabel_8.5x11_1072020.pdf): 3.5 mL per inch DBH in trees less than 12 in; 3.5 to 5.0 for trees 12 to 24 in; 5.0 to 7.0 in trees greater than 24 in.
Mn-jet Fe insert rev 8.2017 (arborjet.com): Low Rate 5 mL/inch DBH (early summer to maturity, through the growing season); High Rate 10-15 mL/inch DBH (late summer or fall).
PALM-jet Mg label (arborjet.com PALM-jet-Mg_Website_Label.pdf): Small 6-12 ft spread = 5-10 mL/palm; Medium 12-24 ft = 10-20 mL/palm; Large 24-48 ft = 20-30 mL/palm.
